claims.statement: All API data fetching goes through TanStack Query hooks under src/hooks/api/; mutations are optimistic where safe and use stable resource-prefixed query keys, and the Axios client handles JWT injection, refresh, and X-Request-Id correlation with backend logs.

The shadcn/ui config (components.json) uses style=default, baseColor=slate, cssVariables=true with the @/ path aliases for components/hooks/lib/utils; the design system is Navy & Gold on Tailwind CSS.

The service worker (frontend/src/sw.ts) is Workbox-driven via vite-plugin-pwa: it caches the app shell, the last-read timesheet summary, and the static icons, and handles web-push events from the browser Push API.

Contexts (AuthContext, UserPreferencesContext, AppStateContext, MetadataContext, BankAccountWarningContext, BottomNavContext, CommandPaletteContext, ShortcutContext) are intentionally narrow; cross-cutting heavy state moves into TanStack Query cache or a Zustand store.
Forms use react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers/zod with Zod schemas mirroring the backend DTOs; this gives end-to-end typed validation from request to API.

The desktop+mobile parity rule is non-negotiable: every change covers 1280px desktop and 390px mobile for Admin and Partner independently; 320px is also verified for dense content, long Vietnamese text, full currency values, tables, dialogs, and sheets.
All UI text is Vietnamese with no i18n abstraction; strings are inline in components or in DTO tables for server-supplied labels, and the convention is enforced by code review.
